GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover throughout. Rider reported that although the gelding, which was first up from a spell today, raced three wide throughout, in his opinion it was disappointing. He added that the gelding may appreciate stepping up in distance. Post race vet - No abs.. Follow up. Stable rep advised the gelding was not suited to racing wide throughout. Also advised it was now the intention to step the gelding up in distance for its next race start.
